syringes.label: U-100 insulin, 1 mL (100 units)
syringes.description: Most common insulin syringe. Marks every 2 units, numbered every 10.

syringes.label: U-100 insulin, 0.3 mL (30 units)
syringes.description: Marks every unit, numbered every 5. Best for small draws.

syringes.label: U-100 insulin, 0.3 mL, half-unit marks
syringes.description: Half-unit marks, numbered every 5 units. Check your syringe: not all 0.3 mL syringes have them.

syringes.label: U-40 insulin, 1 mL (40 units)
syringes.description: Veterinary insulin syringe; 40 units per mL. Units are NOT interchangeable with U-100.

syringes.label: 1 mL tuberculin (mL marks)
syringes.description: Graduated in mL: marks every 0.01 mL, numbered every 0.1 mL.

syringes.label: 3 mL syringe (mL marks)
syringes.description: Graduated in mL: marks every 0.1 mL, numbered every 0.5 mL. Mostly for adding water to a vial.
